summary: Perf critic, acceptance round 2. All tests ran in the real game at 1920x1080 on this M1 Max; scripts and screenshots are in shots/accept/r2-perf/. Other critics' browsers loaded the machine (load average 35-47) for part of the session, so every timing-sensitive number was re-measured when the load fell to 6-11. VERIFYING ROUND 1. All 3 majors are fixed. (1) Start/restart freeze, fixed: core's warm-up compiles 48-54 programs behind the loading screen. The 12-13 fade programs from species' ShaderWarmup compile 10-37 ms after show('race'), while the loading screen is still mounted (introtl.mjs), so nothing is visible. After the reveal, the worst frame is 10.4 ms on every track, for both cold starts and restarts. (2) Mid-race fade/extras compiles, fixed: the first respawn fade compiles 0 programs. What remains at KO time is new and belongs to fx (issue 1). (3) Save/URL validation, fixed: 8 corrupt or stale saves and 6 bad URLs all reach a race, each with one repair warning and 0 errors. Round-1 minors: particles at GO, fog-culled props, rider culling (0 calls at 400 m behind), the Retina cap (2560x1440, 119.8 fps on the dpr-2 city), the CSS loading runner and the sim retainer leak are all fixed. The city dressing long task is NOT fixed (issue 3). REAL TIME, high quality, full autopilot races to results on a quiet machine: coast, city and mountain each hold 119.9 fps (the 120 Hz cap), p95 10.2-10.3 ms, p99 10.3-10.4 ms, main-thread frame CPU p50 2.4-3.0 ms and p95 3.6-4.3 ms. GPU per frame (fx.bench) is 1.7-2.3 ms at 1080p and 2.7-3.0 ms during a KO hold. Budget peaks: 351 draw calls (59 % of 600) and 1.27 M triangles (85 % of 1.5 M). All 9 quality x track combinations race to results with 0 console errors, 0 stubs, 0 '[modules] unit threw' and 0 warnings. Medium runs at 112-119 fps with at most 351 calls / 1.23 M triangles; low at 115-119 fps with at most 241 / 0.78 M. Cold start reaches the race in 2.7 s, a restart in 1.1-1.7 s. MEMORY: at every menu return the GPU holds 17-22 geometries and 8-13 textures. Programs stay at 26-70: bounded by the set of tracks visited, flat on repeats. Over 12 cycles of the same track, live three.js, DOM and Function object counts are identical from cycle 2 on, and the heap after GC goes 31.3 to 32.3 MB, flattening out. Over 3 different full races plus 2 restarts the heap goes 39.3 to 46.4 MB, all from first visits. Bus handlers (114) and DOM nodes (375) are constant, and no RaceSession is retained. ROBUSTNESS: after a WebGL context loss and restore mid-race the city renders correctly again (neon and wet road; sheet-ctx-s.jpg). A 3 s page freeze, three resizes and restart spam give 0 errors. tsc: 0 errors. WHAT IS LEFT is first-use shader compiles mid-race and loading-screen blocks. A KO compiles 8 programs because fx's mask warm-up never runs. The police compile when they first spawn, every race. The city dressing is still one 0.6-0.8 s task. On a quiet machine these cost 12-41 ms frames, and the frames around them are perfect, but under load they balloon to 50-224 ms. A polished racer would have none. No majors are left, so this passes at 8/10.

issues.title: First KO still compiles 8 shader programs mid-cinematic: the cast-mask warm-up never runs
issues.detail: Repro: shots/accept/r2-perf/maskkeys.mjs (city; same result with a menu start or ?race=). Before the first KO, renderer.info.programs holds 0 fx.subjectMask programs. __br.fx.testKo() then adds 5 fx.subjectMask variants (keys for skinned, instanced and plain meshes) and 3 shadow-depth variants. kotime.mjs shows they compile 81-99 ms after cine:ko 'start', at the end of the hit-stop just as the 0.1x ramp begins: frames of 16 + 12 ms CPU on a quiet machine. In natural autopilot races the worst racing frame comes from this: city 41.5 ms at s≈953, coast 34.7 ms at s≈1039. Under machine load the same frames take 77-158 ms (firstuse-a.log, ko-a.log). The second KO adds 2 zero-light 'bikes:depth' variants (9-11 ms quiet, 43-84 ms under load). Cause, in post/pipeline.ts: useMask requires cast.size > 0, but state.cine.cast is empty outside a KO, so warm() stays pending until the first real KO. SubjectMask.render (post/mask.ts) does camera.layers.set(30), which also filters out the lights. The next frame's shadow pass is then keyed with 0 lights and compiles new depth variants (species' acceptance request). fx status m6 says 'nothing fx links at first KO'. That is not what happens in the game.
issues.fix: In warm mode, build a temporary cast from every session rider view plus the race:traffic and race:police roots, and render the mask once inside core's warm-up (or compile it with scene.overrideMaterial = mask material via renderer.compile, with fx's HalfFloat target bound). For the mask draw, enable MASK_LAYER on the scene's lights (or keep their layer in the camera mask) so the light state, and with it the shadow-depth keys, stays unchanged. Acceptance: renderer.info.programs does not grow from GO through 3 KOs and a WRECKED.

issues.title: Police corgi is built and its shaders compile mid-race at its first spawn, in every race
issues.detail: police.ts spawn() does 'view ??= new PoliceView(app, session.world)'. The corgi rider view, its MTB and the beacon (toon pole, red and blue MeshBasicMaterial bars with outlines, additive sprites) are therefore created and compiled inside a gameplay frame, after core's warm-up has finished. Repro: firstuse.mjs with __br.race.setHeat(100) gives 4-5 programs and frames of 12-19 ms CPU on a quiet machine, 37-73 ms under load. In natural races: coast s≈1039-1157, a 35 ms frame when quiet and a 223.6 ms frame in the loaded chain run; mountain s≈645-862, 18-52 ms. The view is disposed with the session, so this repeats in every race where the player draws heat.
issues.fix: Create the PoliceView hidden in createPolice() while the session is being built (before game.warmUp), so its materials compile and its meshes upload behind the loading screen. spawn() then only positions it and sets visible = true.

issues.title: City dressing still freezes the loading screen for 0.57-0.83 s in one task (round-1 perf#7 not addressed)
issues.detail: dress.mjs (?debug=1) logs '[track] city dressing: … 824 ms' and one 827 ms long task in stage 摆摊中 PROPS (load average 22). At load 8-16, cold.mjs measures 606 ms on the cold start and 637 / 654 ms on the two restarts; under heavy load it reaches 1062 ms. dressCity (dressing/city/index.ts) runs from makeDress through landmarks, canyon, skyline, neon, streets and life to pools.build() without a single yield. Mountain now yields (no task over 97 ms) and coast stays at or under 105 ms. During the city task the loading % and the road dashes stop and input is dead, and every city restart pays it again. status/env-city.md has no acceptance-round-1 entry.
issues.fix: Make dressCity yield between its stages (landmarks, street walls, canyon, P5 boards and pylons, skyline, far fill, neon, streets, life, pools.build) with 'await breathe()', and report ctx.progress the way dressMountain's stages() does. Target: every task under about 100 ms.

issues.title: Race build still blocks 0.2 s in one task: all 8 rider views are created synchronously
issues.detail: After the track's last breathe (stage 鹈鹕就位 READY), RaceSession.create calls spawnRiders(), which builds 8 rider and bike views plus physics, combat and race logic in one go. That is a 204-236 ms long task on every track (dress.mjs, cold.mjs). The warm-up's drawEverything frame adds another 93-119 ms task (210-417 ms under load). Neither is a visible hitch, because the CSS runner keeps moving, but the loading % and the dashes freeze, and the cold start is about 0.3 s longer than it needs to be.
issues.fix: Make spawnRiders async and await nextFrame() between rider views (RaceSession.create is already async). Optionally split drawEverything into two hidden frames (main pass, then shadow and mirror passes).

issues.title: Billboard art is dropped for the whole race when it decodes later than 2.5 s
issues.detail: signs/art.ts loadBillboardArt races each image against a 2.5 s timer, and the build permanently skips any image that is late. In 3 of 14 fresh-page boots of bad.mjs under machine load the log shows '[track] billboard art not ready after 2500 ms, skipped this build: billboards/coast_1/2/5/6.webp', so that race runs past blank or missing boards. A slow disk or a busy machine has the same effect in the desktop build.
issues.fix: Build every board with a placeholder face and swap the real texture in when the image's decode promise resolves (the cache already keeps the promise), instead of skipping the board for that build.

issues.title: Far bikes have no LOD: 7 rivals 70 m ahead still cost 25-32 draw calls and 150-200k triangles
issues.detail: cull.mjs: rivals 400 m behind now cost 0, thanks to the species fix. At 70 m ahead the 7 riders still draw 32 calls and 201k triangles on coast and city (25 / 152k on mountain), mostly bikes at full detail; species' acc1/cull.mjs shows the same. Peak frames reach 1.24-1.27 M triangles, 83-85 % of the 1.5 M budget, which leaves little room for new dressing.
issues.fix: Add a distance LOD to createBike: a merged low-poly frame with solid wheel discs beyond about 40 m, and no spokes, chain or pedal detail. Switch it from the rider LOD update (actors/lod.ts already tracks distance). Target: at most 8k triangles per far bike.

issues.title: Loading road dashes animate background-position on the main thread, so they stop during every build task
issues.detail: The runner and the bar now glide on compositor transforms (perf#8 fixed). But .br-road-dash uses the br-scroll-lines keyframes (motion.css), which animate background-position, and the % text is written from JS. Both freeze during the 0.2-0.8 s tasks above (city dressing, READY, warm-up frame).
issues.fix: Animate a double-width dash strip with transform: translateX(-86px) keyframes, which run on the compositor, and let the % text follow the CSS bar (or hide it) during long tasks.
